verses.zh: 我儿，你若领受我的言语，存记我的命令，
verses.kjv: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
verses.en: My son, if you take in what I say and keep my commands safe,

verses.zh: 侧耳听智慧，专心求聪明，
verses.kjv: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
verses.en: listening carefully to wisdom and setting your heart on understanding;

verses.zh: 呼求明哲，扬声求聪明，
verses.kjv: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
verses.en: yes, if you call out for good sense and ask loudly for understanding,

verses.zh: 寻找它，如寻找银子，搜求它，如搜求隐藏的珍宝，
verses.kjv: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
verses.en: if you look for it like silver and search for it like hidden treasure,

verses.zh: 你就明白敬畏耶和华，得以认识神。
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.en: then you will understand what it means to respect the LORD, and you will come to know God.

verses.zh: 因为，耶和华赐人智慧；知识和聪明都由他口而出。
verses.kjv: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
verses.en: It is the LORD who gives wisdom; knowledge and understanding come out of his mouth.

verses.zh: 他给正直人存留真智慧，给行为纯正的人作盾牌，
verses.kjv: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
verses.en: He saves up real wisdom for those who do right; he is a shield for people who live honestly.

verses.zh: 为要保守公平人的路，护庇虔敬人的道。
verses.kjv: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
verses.en: He guards the paths of fair people and watches over the way of those who love him.

verses.zh: 你也必明白仁义、公平、正直、一切的善道。
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
verses.en: Then you will understand what is right, what is fair, what is honest — every good path.

verses.zh: 智慧必入你心；你的灵要以知识为美。
verses.kjv: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.en: Wisdom will come into your heart, and knowing things will make you glad.

verses.zh: 谋略必护卫你；聪明必保守你，
verses.kjv: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
verses.en: Good sense will watch over you, and understanding will keep you safe.

verses.zh: 要救你脱离恶道，脱离说乖谬话的人。
verses.kjv: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
verses.en: It will save you from the wrong road, and from people who twist their words.

verses.zh: 那等人舍弃正直的路，行走黑暗的道，
verses.kjv: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.en: Those people leave the straight path and walk in dark ways.

verses.zh: 欢喜作恶，喜爱恶人的乖僻，
verses.kjv: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
verses.en: They are happy doing wrong, and they enjoy how twisted bad people are.

verses.zh: 在他们的道中弯曲，在他们的路上偏僻。
verses.kjv: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
verses.en: Their ways are crooked, and their paths wander off.

verses.zh: 智慧要救你脱离淫妇，就是那油嘴滑舌的外女。
verses.kjv: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
verses.en: Wisdom will save you from a woman who is not your wife, whose smooth words are meant to trick you.

verses.zh: 她离弃幼年的配偶，忘了神的盟约。
verses.kjv: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
verses.en: She left the husband of her young days and forgot the promise she made before God.

verses.zh: 她的家陷入死地；她的路偏向阴间。
verses.kjv: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
verses.en: Her house leads down to death, and her path leads to the place of the dead.

verses.zh: 凡到她那里去的，不得转回，也得不着生命的路。
verses.kjv: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
verses.en: Nobody who goes to her comes back, or finds the road to life again.

verses.zh: 智慧必使你行善人的道，守义人的路。
verses.kjv: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.en: So wisdom will keep you walking the way of good people and on the path of those who do right.

verses.zh: 正直人必在世上居住；完全人必在地上存留。
verses.kjv: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.en: Honest people will live in the land, and those who are whole-hearted will stay in it.

verses.zh: 惟有恶人必然剪除；奸诈的，必然拔出。
verses.kjv: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
verses.en: But bad people will be cut off from the land, and cheats will be pulled up by the roots.
